name: Advisor Perspectives — dshort (formerly dshort.com)
description: The dshort section of Advisor Perspectives (the archive of Doug Short's long-running market/economic charts, now maintained under the Advisor Perspectives brand) publishes long-term charts and commentary on market valuation, margin debt, housing, and other economic series, typically framed against their own historical trend or regression line. Used here as a design/framing reference for how a long-running independent chart series is labeled and updated, not as a data source.

notes: Charts and commentary are free to view on the public site; a paid AP Premium membership adds member-only features (PDF creation, a "forward to a friend" tool) per the membership terms of use.

The site returned HTTP 403 to both an automated WebFetch and a curl request with a standard browser user agent during this research session, so its terms-of-use page could not be read and quoted directly; the summary below is drawn from indexed search-result text, not a verbatim page read, and terms.status is set accordingly.

terms.summary: Advisor Perspectives' membership terms of use restrict copying, reproducing, or redistributing site materials without prior written permission, with limited sharing allowed through member features.

verified.by: Claude (S9 workflow agent chartbooks-a): advisorperspectives.com/dshort and the terms-of-use URL located via search; both blocked automated fetches (403) so the terms page itself was not read directly

notes: Reference only — no chart on this site fetches data from Advisor Perspectives.

terms.status is unverified rather than restricted because the terms page could not be fetched and quoted directly in this session (site returns 403 to automated requests); a future session with browser access should confirm the quote.
